description: This file defines a Orleans grain class named StatelessWorkerScalingGrain and a shared state class. The grain manages activation counts and waiting activations, using a semaphore for synchronization. It implements methods to wait for and release resources, as well as retrieve current activation and waiting counts.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerScalingGrainSharedState
classes.description: Holds shared synchronization primitives and counters for the grain instances, including a semaphore and dictionaries for activation counts and waiting activations.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerScalingGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain marked as StatelessWorker, managing activation counts and synchronizing via a semaphore. Provides methods to wait, release, and query activation states.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Increments the waiting count, waits asynchronously on the semaphore, then decrements the waiting count.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Releases the semaphore, allowing waiting grains to proceed.

methods.name: GetActivationCount
methods.description: Returns the current activation count for this grain.

methods.name: GetWaitingCount
methods.description: Returns the current number of grains waiting.
